text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Something feels different about it now.
Watch out. It might throw a curveball at us.
Hm? It's just splitting up again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか雰囲気が変わったな。
気を付けろよ、
何か仕掛けてくるかもしれねぇぞ。
ん……？　
なんだ、
また分裂かよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Pure numbers won't do you any good.
Doesn't matter how many there are... Wait. Gimme a break!
Just how many are there?! Talk about overkill!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぞろぞろ頭数だけ揃えたって無駄だぜ？
何匹いようが……
って、
おいおい……
何匹いんだよこれ！
増えすぎだろ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four...
Wow. My head's getting all spinny.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一匹、
二匹、
三匹、
四匹……
う～ん、
目がグルグルしてきたさ～

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: No one asked you to seriously count them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
数えようとすんなよ……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter.
They can increase in number as much as they like, but we won't lose.
text_block_list.orig_text:
問題あらしまへん。
何匹でかかってきても、
うちらは倒せへんよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Arthur, Lancelot, Gawain.
You'll be payin' dearly for what you did to them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アーサー、
ランスロット、
ガウェイン。
みんなにひどいことしたケジメ、
つけてもらわなな！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.orig_text:
……すげぇ怒ってんな、
姫さん。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: She's super scary when she gets angry.
text_block_list.orig_text: マホは怒ると怖いからねー……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Makoto, Kaori.
Give each and every one of them a li'l punishment!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトはん、
カオリはん、
一匹残らずお仕置きや！
